architecture.ui: WPF + PowerToys-inspired settings cards (Windows 11 transient DWM acrylic with Accent Policy fallback, 20%-100% opacity, FluentControls ComboBox/Slider/ScrollBar, Mica for Settings; no emoji-based settings icon plates)

native_interop.dpi_scaling: user32.dll GetDpiForWindow + shcore.dll GetDpiForMonitor (accurate multi-monitor scaling, avoids null PresentationSource bug)
native_interop.monitor_positioning: GetCursorPos -> MonitorFromPoint -> GetMonitorInfo (BottomRight, TopRight, TopLeft, BottomLeft, NearCursor; with strict screen-edge 12px clamping)
native_interop.acrylic_blur: dwmapi.dll transient window backdrop (DWMSBT_TRANSIENTWINDOW) plus user32.dll Accent Policy fallback; flyout remains non-layered so DWM can compose real acrylic

subsystems.ClipboardMonitor: Services/ClipboardMonitor.cs (HwndSource message hook, async 5x lock retry, monotonically ordered reads, GetClipboardSequenceNumber-based suppression for internal writes)
subsystems.DataTypeDetector: Services/DataTypeDetector.cs (Configurable filters: HexColor, UnixTimestamp, Json, Url, Base64, quoted CSV/TSV TableData, Code, Image, PlainText; bounds structured parsing to 1 MB)
subsystems.ActionExecutor: Services/ActionExecutor.cs (CopyText, CopyImage, CopyBase64Image, OpenBrowser, GenerateAndCopyQrCode, SaveImageToFile)
subsystems.FlyoutWindowManager: Services/FlyoutWindowManager.cs (Placement: BottomRight, TopRight, TopLeft, BottomLeft, NearCursor; strict screen boundary clamp, accurate DPI)
subsystems.ThemeService: Services/ThemeService.cs (System, Light, Dark dynamic theme switching)
subsystems.TrayIconService: Services/TrayIconService.cs (H.NotifyIcon.Wpf with native Icon, Settings menu, theme & language submenu)
subsystems.LocalizationService: Services/LocalizationService.cs (Auto/Ja/En full i18n dictionary for flyout and settings)
subsystems.FluentControls: Themes/FluentControls.xaml (Windows 11 Fluent ComboBox with vector chevron, Slide popup, 4px track Slider, 6px minimal ScrollBar)
subsystems.SettingsWindow: Views/SettingsWindow.xaml (PowerToys-inspired restrained SettingsCard layout with Mica, text-first setting rows, update controls, neutral local-processing notice, 20%-100% opacity slider)
subsystems.UpdateService: Services/UpdateService.cs (GitHub Releases latest check, SHA-256 manifest verification, silent Inno Setup handoff; automatic checks can be disabled)

distribution.installer: installer/ClipFlyout.iss (Inno Setup 6, self-contained single-file win-x64, multi-language EN/JA)
distribution.package_script: scripts/build-installer.ps1 (requires a 0.x.x version, publishes with matching assembly metadata and a locked NuGet graph)

Json.pattern: Trimmed starts with { or [ and ends with } or ], validated via JsonDocument.Parse

Base64.pattern: data:image/... or valid Base64 encoded string

TableData.pattern: Multi-line TSV (tabs) or CSV (commas) with uniform columns

Code.pattern: Code keywords regex / braces / semicolons / indentation heuristics

PlainText.pattern: Fallback for all other string content

resolved_issues: Fixed ClipToBounds exception on Window by removing illegal ClipToBounds property from transparent Window root in FlyoutWindow.xaml
Fixed screen right-edge overflow: constrained MaxWidth, forced word wrapping, added strict 12px screen boundary clamping
Fixed high-DPI scaling bug: added native GetDpiForWindow / GetDpiForMonitor APIs
Fixed double-tint opacity bug: separated OS hardware blur activation from WPF single-layer tint, expanded opacity slider range to 20%~100%
Fixed JSON action closures referencing a disposed JsonDocument by cloning JsonElement before registering actions
Prevented stale clipboard reads and old hide-animation callbacks from replacing or hiding newer flyouts
Replaced timing-based internal clipboard suppression with Windows clipboard sequence numbers
Added settings validation, atomic saves, and isolated test settings from LocalAppData and the startup registry
Replaced naive CSV splitting with quoted-field CSV/TSV parsing, Markdown escaping, and duplicate-header handling
Removed emoji-led settings decoration, introduced a clear primary flyout action, and rewrote privacy copy as a neutral local-processing note
Updated to v0.3.0 and pinned the tray icon dependency to H.NotifyIcon.Wpf 2.3.0, which supplies compatible modern .NET Windows assets

v0.4.0: replaced layered-window pseudo acrylic with DWM transient acrylic, defined high-contrast dark tray-menu hover states, added secure GitHub Releases automatic updates and visible update controls
v0.4.1: rate-limited automatic update checks, atomically staged downloads, restored post-update launch for silent installs, locked dependencies, and updated QRCoder to 1.8.0

v0.5.0: acrylic opacity is now applied by the Windows compositor, submenu palettes are explicit in dark mode, light flyouts use a light compositor tint, accent presets were added, and email addresses are detected
